name: M-52 concussion missile
description: The M-52 concussion missile was a model of concussion missile that could be launched from starships. In 3 ABY, the Trailblazer, an EML-850 light freighter, was equipped with M-52 concussion missiles when the thief Kay Vess stole it from the Imperial Security Bureau Director Sliro Barsha's Westhill Palace in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
